likely_cause: Inverter cooling fan obstruction/failure or stuck relay drawing parasitic current during standby.
next_checks: Inspect inverter cabinet exhaust fans and air filters for blockages.
Check DC/AC contactor status and auxiliary power draw via SCADA.
Perform thermal imaging on IGBT heatsink assembly before morning ramp-up.

next_checks: Review SCADA gearbox oil temperature and pressure alarms.
Inspect nacelle accelerometer spectrum for bearing frequency peaks.
Verify blade pitch angle calibration against current wind speed.
